Brand icons from @lobehub/icons-static-svg 1.95.1 (MIT), https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons.
Color variants (`<name>-color.svg`) copied as `<name>.svg`; `nousresearch.svg` is the mono icon
recoloured from currentColor to the site's ink colour so it shows on the dark menu.
The logos remain the trademarks of their owners and only identify each model's vendor.
`nvidia.svg` is `nvidia-color.svg` from the same package version. `generic.svg` is drawn for this site
(a chip outline in the site's ink colour) and stands in for any model with no known vendor, such as TinyLlama.
`cloudflare.svg` and `openrouter.svg` are simple marks drawn for this site (a cloud, and two routed arrows); they only stand in for the providers named in the Provider column.
`ollama.svg` is a simple llama-face mark drawn for this site; it only stands in for the Ollama provider in the Provider column.
`auto.svg` is a sparkle mark drawn for this site; it stands for the Auto row (the server picks the model).
